QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_6

question.text: Incentive Fees (Performance Fees) for Category III AIFs are generally charged in the range of:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 6.1.1, incentive fees are charged as 0-20% of incremental return over the hurdle. **The Trap:** Higher flat rates (50%) are not used in the Indian AIF industry. **Cross-Exam Context:** Lower than some offshore hedge fund norms which can reach 25%. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Benchmark the incentive fee % against peers with similar strategy before signing the PPM.
